errors.payment_readiness_invalid: App readiness checks must return bounded status and safe explanatory text.
errors.payment_forbidden: You cannot manage this billable account.
errors.payment_request_invalid: Supply a stable checkout request identifier.
errors.payment_subscription_exists: Manage the existing subscription through billing instead of starting another checkout.
errors.payment_history_unavailable: Billing history could not be loaded. Check provider access and retry.
errors.payment_reconciliation_required: Provider inspection did not resolve this request.
errors.payment_customer_conflict: This provider customer is already bound to a different billable subject.
errors.payment_catalogue_uncertain: Catalogue publication stopped. Inspect the pending provider request before retrying; completed items are preserved.
errors.payment_balance_limit: Credit balance exceeds the supported integer range.
errors.payment_feature_required: Your subscription does not include this feature.
errors.payment_insufficient_credits: Not enough credits for this action.
errors.payment_debit_missing: No debit exists for this reference.
errors.payment_customer_unbound: Bind this provider customer before processing its events.

scope.readinessMismatch: Readiness returned a different payment account or environment.
scope.catalogueMismatch: Catalogue scope does not match its configured environment.
scope.merchantMismatch: The payment scope does not match this environment's merchant configuration.

operation.unfinished: Inspect the unfinished provider request before retrying.
operation.mayHaveSucceeded: Inspect this account's provider activity before retrying; the request may have succeeded.

input.billingEmail: Supply the authenticated billing contact's email.
input.historyPage: Select billing subscriptions or transactions and a valid page cursor.
input.recoveryObjectId: Supply the exact provider object ID to recover.
input.reference: Use a nonempty business reference of at most 150 characters.
input.creditQuantity: Use a positive integer credit quantity, at most one billion.
input.timestamp: Use an integer UTC timestamp in milliseconds.

reference.otherPlan: The checkout request already selected another plan.
reference.differentInputs: This business reference was already used with different inputs.

provider.checkAccount: Check the {provider} account, price mapping and subscription shape.
provider.unsupportedEvent: The event is not a supported subscription payment for this customer.
provider.objectIdMissing: The provider did not return an object ID.
provider.subscriptionBinding: Check the provider subscription and logical price binding.
provider.renewalBinding: Check the renewal's logical price binding.

webhook.rawBodyRequired: Supply the unmodified webhook request bytes.

configuration.taxCategoryUnpublishable: Set the application's Paddle product tax category before publishing.
configuration.sharedConnectionRequired: Select a shared Stripe or Paddle connection with a backend API-key Env reference for {environment}.
configuration.paddleEnvironment: Select a Paddle connection configured for {environment}.
configuration.paddleTaxCategory: Choose the Paddle tax category for the products this app sells.
configuration.paddleClientToken: Set the Env reference for this environment's Paddle public client token.

catalogue.reviewFirst: Review the current catalogue and resolve provider drift or unfinished requests first.
catalogue.publicationChanged: Another publication changed the catalogue; review again.
catalogue.recoveryReviewChanged: The recovery review changed. Inspect the current pending operation first.
catalogue.objectMismatch: The provider object does not match the pending operation.
